description: This file contains a GitHub integration helper class that interacts with GitHub repositories, parses Python files to identify class and function definitions, and manages pull requests for code updates and testing. It also includes a visitor class for AST parsing to detect FastAPI endpoints and app definitions.

classes.name: DefinitionVisitor
classes.description: AST visitor class to identify class, function, and FastAPI endpoint definitions within Python source files.

classes.name: RepoHelper
classes.description: Helper class to interact with GitHub repositories, parse Python files for class/function definitions, and manage pull requests for code updates and testing.

methods.name: enrich_node_with_github_data
methods.description: Enriches a node with GitHub file path, function implementation details, and file content.

methods.name: create_pull_request_with_new_function
methods.description: Creates a pull request to update a function's implementation based on new code and context.

methods.name: create_pull_request_with_test
methods.description: Creates a pull request adding a new test file to the repository.

methods.name: create_pull_request_with_multiple_tests
methods.description: Creates a pull request with multiple test files and coverage summary.
